title: Peek-a-Boo
desc: You played peek-a-boo for the first time and laughed, and your dad has not stopped talking about it since. It became his thing with you, and yours with him.
story: Dad was sitting with you, using your own little feet to play peek-a-boo, hiding behind them and popping out with that big goofy expression he saves just for you. And then it happened, you laughed, a real, bright, delighted laugh that told him you understood exactly what was going on. That moment landed somewhere deep, because it was the first time a game passed between you two, a real back and forth, a tiny inside joke. Ever since then, peek-a-boo has been your dad's signature move, and honestly, he needs it just as much as you do.
